narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved across parts of northeast Illinois during the afternoon of July 27th producing very heavy rain and localized flash flooding in Elmhurst.
ev: Flooding was reported in numerous areas in Elmhurst. Multiple roads were flooded near North Avenue and Interstate 294. Two to three feet of water was reported on streets near the intersection of North Avenue and North York Street. An underpass on Robert Palmer Drive was flooded near 1st Street. Water entered a nearby apartment building and parking garage. Basement flooding was also reported. A personal weather station reported 2.28 inches of rain in one hour on the southeast side of Elmhurst and another personal weather station reported 2.10 inches of rain in one hour on the northeast side of Elmhurst.
lsr: 2 to 3 feet of water on streets near the intersection of North Avenue and North York Street in Elmhurst. Relayed via social media.
